{{Quote|I knew I could rely on you. Jormun Shade, an Internal Security officer, just lost his Zabrak bodyguard to an assassin. Fortunately, Shade was undetected by the killer but is now understandably concerned about returning here without an armed escort. Make sure he gets here alive. Imperial Intelligence must hear what he has discovered.|Tour Aryon|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Jormun Shade''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] of [[Internal Security Branch|Internal Security]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jormun Shade was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
